title: ElasticMM: Efficient Multimodal LLMs Serving with Elastic Multimodal Paral

predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: Abstract claims: 'reducing TTFT by up to 6.8× and achieving 5.1–7.2× higher throughput'. Introduction and conclusion claim only up to 4.2× TTFT reduction and 3.2–4.5× throughput improvement over vLLM. The experimental results in Section 4.2 do not support the 6.8× or 5.1–7.2× numbers against any reported baseline.

The textual representation of Figure 6 shows vLLM at SLO 1.0 with ~250 throughput, DistServe at 1.0 with ~450 and a parenthetical (4.5×). Multiplying vLLM's 250 by 4.5 gives 1125, not 450. The multiplier is arithmetically inconsistent with the displayed throughput values, making the figure unreliable.
